verdict.rationale: Databricks says it 'runs directly on your data lake' using Delta Lake 'without moving your data' (docs-32, docs-68). This implies your data stays in your own lake storage. OpenSharing also lets you share data with users outside your organization 'regardless of whether they use Databricks' (docs-17). Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-export or offboarding capability, a statement that the storage formats are open, export paths for non-table assets (notebooks, dashboards, models), and independent corroboration of leaving cleanly.
